title: Quarry Hill opens two hours late today; Old Mill and Weaver Street release early for conferences
summary: Quarry Hill Elementary starts at 9:50 am after a boiler repair. Old Mill and Weaver Street dismiss at 12:45 pm for family conferences. All other schools are on their regular schedule.
body:
Quarry Hill Elementary opens at 9:50 am today while a boiler valve is replaced. Buses run two hours later than usual, and breakfast is served at 9:40 am.

Old Mill and Weaver Street dismiss at 12:45 pm for family conferences. Lunch is served before dismissal.

All other schools are on the regular bell schedule. Status changes are posted here and on each school's page.

title: Board adopts a revised attendance policy after two readings
summary: Policy 4120 now counts the first two days of a family emergency as excused, and asks schools to call home after the second unexplained absence.
body:
At its October 20 regular meeting the board voted 6–1 to adopt revised Policy 4120, Student attendance, after first and second readings in September and October.

The revised policy takes effect November 2. Schools will call home after a second unexplained absence in a month, not the third.

title: Fernhall's dual-language strand adds a family Spanish class
summary: Thursday evenings in the library, for parents and caregivers of dual-language students. Childcare is provided.
body: Families asked for a way to help with homework in both languages. Starting November 5, Fernhall hosts a free six-week Spanish class for caregivers on Thursday evenings, with childcare in the gym.

title: Northgate culinary students run the district's first pop-up café
summary: The café in the district office lobby is open Tuesdays and Thursdays through December, staffed by Northgate culinary arts students.
body: Students in Northgate's culinary arts program plan the menu, cost it and serve it. Proceeds go back to the program's supply budget (story).

title: Saskell Creek High marching band places second at the regional festival
summary: The Creekers marching band finished second of 22 bands at the (fictional) Three Rivers festival with its show “Riverworks.”
body: The band's 118 students rehearsed since July. The final home performance is at the November 13 football game.

title: Bus route changes on the Ridge line start November 2
summary: Routes 12, 14 and 15 change stop times by three to eight minutes to serve the new Ostby Road crossing.
body: Transportation reviewed ride times on the Ridge line after the Ostby Road crossing opened. Route 14 morning pickups move eight minutes earlier. Signed-in families see their student's updated stop time in the family hub.

title: Kestle Mill agriculture students raise the district's first FFA greenhouse
summary: A 30-by-60 foot greenhouse funded by a (fictional) state agriculture grant, built by students over six Saturdays.
body: The greenhouse will grow seedlings for every elementary garden club in the district this spring.
